Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Science fiction and fantasy illustrator Randy Vargas’s first contribution to Magic was two cards in 2017’s Hour of Devastation. Ever since, Randy has been bringing unforgettable scenes to life across multiple sets like Adventures in the Forgotten Realms, Throne of Eldraine, Zendikar Rising and more. With this series, Randy brings his dynamic and captivating style to a truly amazing set of cards, which includes the first reprint of Grand Abolisher since Archenemy: Nicol Bolas in 2017 and the first non-List reprint of Umezawa’s Jitte since 2016.

Contents:
• 1x Grand Abolisher
• 1x Selfless Savior
• 1x Akroma, Angel of Fury
• 1x Umezawa’s Jitte
